[LINT.1.4] **An `Interval` is not a slot type.** It is a value of the
expression language with no slot representation, so the compiler **must**
refuse a schema slot declared `Interval` or `Interval<T>` for any `T` with
`DS_VALIDATE_BAD_TYPE`. A fact carries an interval as its two endpoints, or, for
an `Interval<Time>` or `Interval<Date>`, as a `Json` string in the form
[LINT.8.1] gives.
